collection.title: KGM Rexton 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The KGM Rexton 2022 Onwards version uses a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" wiper blade on the passengers side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
